parole.significato: polytonous gray (with varying shades of gray)
parole.testo: According to Georgiev (BER), of Thracian origin, ultimately from Proto-Indo-European *g⁽ʷ⁾ʰreh₁wos (the shift of Thracian *-ē- to Bulgarian -и- (-i-) is also reflected in Bulgarian Пловдив (Plovdiv), from an earlier Latin Pulpudēva), cognate with Proto-Germanic *grēwaz and Latin rāvus. Also inherite

Likely from an unattested Old Bulgarian root *кате́рь (*katérʹ, “squirrel”), cf. катеричка. In turn from Thracian *kater-, from Proto-Indo-European *(s)koktér or *(s)kaktér from the roots *(s)kok- (“to jump”) or *(s)kat- (“to jump”) respectively.
